auth.sse: consume with fetch streaming and an Authorization header; EventSource URL form is not supported (no credentials in URLs)

scenario_b.label_meaning: Label VALID means only: release-profile gateway and driver binaries (gateway profile inferred from the directory directly above the executable), >= 10 repetitions per arm, BASE arm present, workload parameters within tolerance of the documented experiment (phases >= half of 8/5/10/8 s, arrival rate and key catalogue within 0.5x..2x of 300 rps and 5000 keys), one host, scripted origin. It is not a statement of statistical validity beyond the mechanical rule, of generality, or of adaptive-control merit.
label_reasons: phantom-lab / lab_live library built in the DEBUG profile
gateway binary profile is 'debug' (path <path>), not release
